description: This is a header file (.h) containing function declarations for the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) API, specifically export APIs related to certificate attributes. It defines functions for creating certificate attributes, possibly with naming options, intended for use across a platform-independent PKI implementation.

methods.name: PKICreateCertAttribute
methods.description: Creates a certificate attribute, returning a handle to the created object.

methods.name: PKICreateCertAttributeWithName
methods.description: Creates a certificate attribute with a specified RFC2253 name, returning a handle.
